Hey, it's that time of the week again, about time when we should consider thinking about what the next age will be. I remember Phyra had a proposition for the Age of Order, and this would be a good time to gauge the interest in [that idea](https://voat.co/v/SavageGods/comments/813214/4030912). Otherwise, it would be great if everybody could post their suggestions below.

I'm not nearly as good at this kind of inquiry stuff as Silvester is, but I do hope that despite his busy-ness we can continue to keep things running somewhat smoothly.

###### Amendment 1: Actual serious suggestions please.
Lets continue in the age of exploration, and can we slow down on the ages? They feel like time is going by too fast.

I honestly wanted to peel back from the age of exploration, I don't think we're even developed enough to have such an age. Age of exploration requires technologies that we didn't have initially, that led to a lot of tech leaps. I do agree that calling them ages suggests the passage of large amounts of time, but I think in game time is progressing actually rather slowly.

So lets hold age changes every month instead, so we can develop right.

Also, changing into an age requires learning new tech. We weren't in the industrial age IRL before the first industrial machine.

I personally think that the next age should be the "Age of Settlers", in which the races of Gaea either establish more cities or establish a city. This would then be proceeded by the "Age of Maps", in which the exploration that is done will actually be meaningful. By meaningful, I mean races will have the technology to record their findings on a map. After that, the long awaited "Age of Civilizations" can finally dawn.

Or, we could just continue the "Age of Exploration", and not end every age after a week. I never got why each age ended after a week. Ages throughout actual history varied greatly in length, so why can't the Ages of Gaea. On that note, I don't understand why there has to be an "Age of Strife" and a "Second Age of Strife", when both could be compressed into one age, and we could all say it was a longer age that all others before it.

Perhaps we can rethink the idea of having a new age every time, this should probably be something to bring up at the sabbath post or whatnot. I do think you are right to say ages do not have to have fixed lengths. Honestly I'm just going by tradition here :P.

I also like the idea of just rolling back to Age of Settlers, get more development of the races before we send everyone out exploring everything. I doubt we really want to be making an Age of Exploration, which happened really late on our world, just quite yet.

We could just rename this age from "Age of Exploration" to "Dawn of Species" or something. I say "Dawn of Species" because their were a lot of new species who came into the game, as well as the species that existed became more powerful and began really interacting with other species.

I like the idea of having less age changes. Age of settlers or some other building-up age seems good too, we haven't had enough of those. I feel like we should have an Age of Artifacts sometime after which is just devoted to creation stories for cool artifacts for later ages.
